_body:
Cue: Acme release notes command fails with error E42 when missing required tag argument
Text: Include the --since-tag argument with the value 'none' to successfully generate release notes.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag none"}
```

Cue: Makefile test target requires initialised workspace
Text: Run the bootstrap target before the test target, e.g., "make bootstrap && make test".

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test","timeout":120}
```

Cue: migrate.sh status fails with "no database configured"
Text: Append the --db flag with the appropriate database connection string to the command.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db","timeout":30}
```

Cue: Running an acme build command that requires a profile
Text: You must include the --profile flag with either dev or prod as its argument.

Failed:
```
error: --profile is required (dev|prod)
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme build --profile dev","timeout":120}
```

Cue: File not found due to incorrect absolute path
Text: Use a relative path starting with ./ instead of an absolute path when reading local repository files.

Failed:
```
Error reading /home/user/repos/evangelyne/lib/strings.sh: open /home/user/repos/evangelyne/lib/strings.sh: no such file or directory
```

Worked:
```
{"file_path":"./lib/strings.sh"}
```
